· Significantly below SMA100/200($8.30/$10.41), maintaining a weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (5.1%) + Current price range near historical lows.

[Support & Resistance Structure]

[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Consider buying upon confirmation of RSI settling in the neutral zone after exiting oversold.
